hunks.baseline: The cliffs flanking Eight Spring Gorge were practically enormous walls in their own right.
hunks.sol: The cliffs flanking Eight Spring Gorge were enormous walls in their own right.

hunks.baseline: To go around the cliffs and reach this place, an army would have to spend days crossing rugged mountain ridges. To break through head-on, they would have to climb the sheer rock face rising into the sky.
hunks.sol: To go around the cliffs and reach this place, an army would have to spend days crossing rugged mountain ridges. To break through head-on, they would have to climb the rock face towering above them.

hunks.baseline: Of course, that wasn’t impossible in itself.
hunks.sol: Of course, that wasn’t impossible.

hunks.baseline: It was commonly accepted that even an experienced Mountain Herb Gatherer or hunter could climb one over a long period of time, provided they made sufficient preparations.
hunks.sol: It was generally accepted that even an experienced Mountain Herb Gatherer or hunter could climb the cliffs given enough preparation and time. The uneven rock offered plenty of handholds and footholds.

hunks.baseline: The uneven cliff face gave them footholds for their hands and feet, after all.
But—
If a thousand archers filled the cliffs on either side of the gorge and had no intention of welcoming their uninvited guests, that changed everything.
hunks.sol: But that was a different story if the thousand archers stationed atop the cliffs on either side of the gorge had no intention of welcoming visitors.

hunks.baseline: Just as it did now.
hunks.sol: As they did now.

hunks.baseline: The nomads surged toward the cliffs like a swarm of ants, their cries impossible to distinguish as screams or battle shouts.
hunks.sol: The nomads surged toward the cliffs like a swarm of ants, their cries somewhere between screams and battle shouts.

hunks.baseline: At that very moment, the officers, their sharp eyes fixed on the scene in the darkness below, spoke as one.
hunks.sol: At that moment, the officers watching the darkness below gave their orders in unison.

hunks.baseline: A red flag, its color barely discernible in the dark, plunged down like lightning. At once, a thousand tightly drawn bowstrings were finally set free.
hunks.sol: A red flag, its color barely discernible in the dark, dropped like lightning. At once, a thousand taut bowstrings were set free.

hunks.baseline: Arrows shot through the faint moonlight quivered as they flew, as if they knew what awaited them at the end of their brief journey.
hunks.sol: Arrows quivered as they cut through the faint moonlight, as if they knew what awaited them at the end of their brief journey.

hunks.baseline: But the expression of the man watching the gruesome sight from atop the distant cliffs remained grim.
hunks.sol: But the man watching the gruesome scene from high atop the cliff looked grim.

hunks.baseline: A faint, clear light shone in his eyes—a sign that he had mastered high-level martial arts, and that he could pierce the darkness spread out below.
hunks.sol: A faint, clear light shone in his eyes—a sign that he had mastered high-level martial arts and could see through the darkness below.

hunks.baseline: *Their losses are smaller than expected. Even if they abandoned their horses in advance and used shields to protect themselves, this is…*
hunks.sol: *Their losses are smaller than expected. Even if they abandoned their horses beforehand and came prepared with shields, this is…*

hunks.baseline: After a moment’s thought, the man made his decision and raised his baton. His adjutant, standing by with a tense expression, tied his superior’s order to an arrow and shot it toward the opposite cliff.
hunks.sol: After a moment’s thought, the man raised his baton. His adjutant, waiting with a tense expression, tied his superior’s order to an arrow and shot it toward the opposite cliff.

hunks.baseline: It was still an arrow, though it traced a smooth arc.
And yet the moment it arrived with a sharp whistle, it was caught as if sucked into someone’s hand.
hunks.sol: The arrow traced a smooth arc, but it was still an arrow. Yet as it came whistling in, someone caught it as easily as if it had flown straight into his hand.

hunks.baseline: Effortlessly, at that.
The old man caught the arrow without looking, untied the missive fastened to its shaft, and handed it to an officer nearby. Clad in armor, the officer quickly scanned its contents.
hunks.sol: The old man caught the arrow without looking, untied the missive fastened to its shaft, and handed it to an officer nearby. The armored officer quickly scanned its contents.

hunks.baseline: “He says that, judging by how sharply their casualties have fallen, the enemy must have sent in their elite troops.”
hunks.sol: “He says the enemy must have sent in their elite troops. Their casualties have fallen sharply.”

hunks.baseline: “That’s a headache, but… well, it might actually be a good thing for us.”
hunks.sol: “That’s a headache, but… it might actually work in our favor.”

hunks.sol: The old man waved a hand, patted his lower back, and stood. Something dark and dull was already in his hand.

hunks.baseline: It was far too long to be called a cane, reaching nearly a *jang*. And it struck the rock with a weight that made it hard to call it wood.
hunks.sol: At nearly a *jang* long, it was far too long to be a cane. And the sound it made against the rock was too heavy for wood.

hunks.sol: *“Senior, I’ll need you to take the cliffs.”*

hunks.baseline: The old man’s objection was reasonable on the face of it.
hunks.sol: The old man’s objection was reasonable enough.

hunks.sol: Of the fifteen thousand troops, a thousand carefully selected archers held the cliffs and rained arrows down from above. How many enemies could possibly make it up alive? What need was there for a powerful master?

hunks.baseline: But Jin Wikyung’s immediate answer had been firm.
hunks.sol: But Jin Wikyung had answered without hesitation.

hunks.sol: *“Our allies on the ground will fight to the death with everything they have. It’s only a matter of time before the enemy targets the cliffs, and their very best troops will be among those they send.”*

hunks.baseline: *“And you want this old man to stop those elites?”*
hunks.sol: *“And you want this old man to stop them?”*

hunks.baseline: *“If we can stop them from scaling the cliffs, we can deal them a major blow. If we hold that position to the end, we can level the scales, even though they’re tipped so heavily against us.”*
hunks.sol: *“If we stop them from scaling the cliffs, we can deal them a major blow. Hold that position to the end, and we can level the scales, even though they’re tipped heavily against us.”*

hunks.baseline: Only then had the old man remembered.
hunks.sol: Only then had the old man remembered something.

hunks.baseline: Though he’d known him for less than a year, the Lesser Family Head of the Jin Family of Taiyuan had always made the wise choice.
hunks.sol: He had known the Lesser Family Head of the Jin Family of Taiyuan for less than a year, but in all that time, Jin Wikyung had always made the wise choice.

hunks.baseline: *“Fine. I’ll land you a big fish in this battle, just like you want.”*
hunks.sol: *“Fine. I’ll land you a big fish in this battle, just as you want.”*

hunks.baseline: *“Don’t worry. I’ve already owed the Jin Family of Taiyuan my life twice. This time, I’ll repay every bit of it.”*
hunks.sol: *“Don’t worry. I already owe the Jin Family of Taiyuan my life twice. This time, I’ll repay that debt in full.”*

hunks.baseline: The older they were, and the more Fame they had built, the more so.
hunks.sol: The older they were, and the more Fame they had earned, the truer that became.

hunks.baseline: And the old man was both old and renowned.
hunks.sol: The old man was both old and renowned.

hunks.baseline: He had spent his whole life in his hometown, never belonging to any sect. Even after reaching the lofty realm of Supreme Peak, he had never left it.
hunks.sol: He had spent his entire life in his hometown, never joining a sect. Even after reaching the lofty realm of Supreme Peak, he had stayed there.

hunks.baseline: He’d intended to lay his bones in the place where he was born and raised.
hunks.sol: He’d meant to lay his bones in the place where he was born and raised.

hunks.baseline: That is, until the day he lost his mind, soon after meeting a woman of extraordinary beauty.
hunks.sol: Until the day he met a woman of extraordinary beauty and, soon afterward, lost his mind.

hunks.baseline: “At last… the time has come to repay my debt.”
hunks.sol: “At last… the time has come to repay my debts.”

hunks.baseline: The old man murmured in a low voice.

hunks.sol: He owed more than gratitude to the Jin Family of Taiyuan, who had restored the mind taken from him against his will and spent months treating his grievous injuries.

hunks.sol: Then a red flash flickered through the dense silver net spread across the cliff.
